record_title: Quartic endpoint stability and translation bifurcation for the Gaussian volume product
limitations: The theorem is restricted to translations of the fixed Euclidean unit ball and does not establish full shape stability or global optimality in dimensions n>=3. The emerging nonzero branch is locally maximal only within the translated-ball family. The motivating preprint is very recent, leaving residual revision and parallel-work risk. No independent validation is asserted.
